name: Flip and cancel
rule: Fraction ÷ fraction: keep the first, change ÷ to ×, flip the second. Cancel matching numbers before you multiply.
why: Dividing by 1/2 asks how many halves fit, which is times 2. Flipping the second fraction turns every division into a times.

clues: Which fraction gets flipped? Only the one after the ÷.
Look for numbers to cancel across the top and bottom, then multiply.
